dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I play volleyball. And you?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ ˈpleɪ ˈvɑːlibɔːl. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I play basketball. And computer games!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈpleɪ ˈbæskɪtbɔːl. ənd kəmˈpjuːtər ˌɡeɪmz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! I play games on my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! aɪ ˈpleɪ ˈɡeɪmz ɑːn maɪ ˈfoʊn.
